simulation_type: deterministic hybrid kinematic and rigid-body visual simulation
validation_status: seven trips now use explicit reach, grip, lift, carry, align, lower, release, and settle stages; stage-driven body pose added; visual hand mesh and solver checks remain unvalidated
motion_model: Each trip is authored as approach, reach, grip, lift, carry, align, lower, release, and settle events. Both views follow one deterministic timeline. Grasped transport follows authored paths; release hands items to the fixed-step AABB contact solver with gravity, friction, and limited yaw rotation. The operator uses stage-driven bend poses and a damped inverted-pendulum balance controller.
assumptions: Object transport follows authored task paths.
Pickup and release are scripted grasp events.
The room geometry and object dimensions are illustrative rather than measured.
Suitcase dimensions are illustrative; layout checks only test the authored model bounds.
not_validated: Full musculoskeletal human balance and joint forces
asset_limitations: The reference repository does not publish the main assembly avatar generator or a reusable figure mesh.
Its anatomical hand experiment is separate from the full assembly avatar and is not integrated into this two-view packing playback.
